proposal.signature: (width:natural n, ON:set of n-bit ranks, DC:set of n-bit ranks disjoint ON)->ordered list of n-literal ternary cubes
proposal.law: Let U={0,...,2^n-1}, ON∩DC=∅ and OFF=U\(ON∪DC). A cube is an n-character pattern in {0,1,-}, where '-' is free. Return EVERY and ONLY cube c whose coverage intersects ON, whose coverage has empty intersection with OFF, and for which no strictly less constrained cube c' (covering strictly more assignments) also avoids OFF. Sort cubes by canonical lexicographic order '-'<'0'<'1'. The output is the complete prime implicant family, NOT a chosen minimum cover and not an individual Boolean gate.
proposal.width_policy: Research executable oracle n≤4 for bounded checks; mathematical law for any finite natural n subject to explicit finite-input resource policy.
proposal.zero_width: n=0 has one assignment, rank 0; ON={0} produces ['']; ON=∅ produces [].
falsifiers: A reported prime cube can free another constrained bit without touching OFF.
ON coverage is lost or cubes covering only DC are reported.
Returns one minimized sum-of-products cover rather than all primes.
Treats a don't-care as mandatory output-1 or silently allows overlapping ON/DC.
